name: lishechap
description: LisheChap: Swahili-first food discovery, real-time availability verification, ordering and delivery-support platform.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,client --prefix-colors yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
